name: Consent
description: Cookie consent bar with accept and decline. Consent is denied by default: until the visitor explicitly accepts, <html data-consent> is "denied" (set before first paint) and nothing may start measurement. The choice is stored in localStorage (`kit-consent`), set as <html data-consent="granted|denied"> and dispatched as a `kit:consent` event on document with {granted}; the site-settings analytics gate reads data-consent and loads analytics only when it is "granted". The bar shows only while no choice is stored, with no flash on later visits.

position.description: bottom: a full-width bar along the bottom edge. corner: a small card in the bottom corner.

message.label: Message
message.description: What the site stores and why, in a sentence or two.

policyHref.label: Policy link
policyHref.description: Privacy or cookie policy page, linked after the message.

regionLabel.description: Accessible name of the bar's region (ui:).

a11y: A labelled region, not a modal: no focus trap, the page stays usable. Both choices are native buttons in reading order after the message; the policy link is a real link. Once a choice is made the bar is hidden (not just moved off screen).
